thread:
mira (acct-rec): Incoming SEPA credit from GlobalBank for €23,456 just posted to nostro, but there is no invoice or PO number we can match. bank attached a short note: 'ERP#INV-0000; TAXID:XX123' — our parser returned empty reference.

olivia (payments): Can you paste the raw remittance text? sometimes banks put it in the optional field and our importer strips special chars.

mira (acct-rec): Here — copied from the MT103 message we received:
```
:70:ERP#INV-0000 / TAXID:XX123 / CUSTOMER: Acme Ltd.
:86:/ACC/GBL/REF:INV-0000; PAYOR-ID=CB-987654; /* special chars present */
```
I also attached the CSV from our bank feed (snippet):
```
date,amount,currency,beneficiary,remittance
2026-03-16,23456,EUR,ACME LTD,"ERP#INV-0000; TAXID:XX123"
```

sam (ops): Looks like the reference has a leading "ERP#" prefix — our mapping rules only look for bare invoice numbers and PO: patterns. I can add a quick regex to accept ERP#INV-\d+ but want to confirm this won't cause false matches.

olivia (payments): Before changing prod rules, can we try to map this txn manually? mira, what ERP number shows in Acme's sent remittance?

mira (acct-rec): Acme support confirms their payment shows invoice ID INV-0000 in their AR system. They used an outbound bank that tokenizes the ref with "ERP#". They can resend confirmation but it's already posted.

payments-bot: Automated note: Payment ID pmt_0a1b23 processed into nostro on 2026-03-16T14:12:03Z. No ledger allocation.

olivia (payments): OK — manual allocation is fine for this ticket, but we need a short-term parser tweak and an incident to ensure similar prefixes get recognized. Sam, can you scope a change and run it against last 30 days of unmatched credits to estimate blast radius?

sam (ops): Will do. Plan: add regex to strip common prefixes (ERP#, PO:, INV-) and re-run reconciliation sweep. I'll run in staging and post results. ETA 3 hours.

mira (acct-rec): Also asking bank-support for MT103 copy and clarifying whether their correspondent trimmed any characters. Bank says sometimes intermediary banks replace slashes with spaces.

bank-support: Confirmed — intermediary trimmed slashes and converted some punctuation to spaces for outgoing rails. Sending full MT103 image via secure link. I recommend checking for 'space-normalized' variants.

olivia (payments): Great. Action items: 1) Sam: run regex patch + reconciliation sweep (3h). 2) Mira: accept manual allocation for this payment and log AR note. 3) Payments team: open a playbook entry for handling "ERP#"/tokenized refs. If sweep finds >20 similar hits, we'll schedule rollback plan. @sam please tag the PR with "finance-recon-erp-prefix".

mira (acct-rec): Done — I've posted allocation and emailed Acme that we matched invoice INV-0000. Closing escalation unless sam finds more. :white_check_mark:
